claim_hierarchy.pilot_scope: After independent authorization only: adapter/load/runtime feasibility on public Phase 0 dev fixtures. It may report operational feasibility observations only; it must not report performance advantage, superiority, non-inferiority, acceptance/pass thresholds, or confirmatory claims.

A_controlled_routing_comparison.primary_claim: For cases with verified routing gold and identical eligible router-visible metadata, report each frozen system's decision-correctness counts and paired case-level differences versus Rules. This is descriptive only until a separately justified inferential design is approved.
A_controlled_routing_comparison.primary_metric: decision correctness = exact correct decisions / assigned cases with verified non-UNKNOWN routing gold
A_controlled_routing_comparison.paired_case_semantics: Same case ID, same canonical serialized metadata and availability state for every included router. Exclude a router from Track A if identical input cannot be shown. Pair differences are case-wise; no independent-sample comparison.
A_controlled_routing_comparison.inferential_method_boundary: Binary paired primary outcome: exact McNemar may be considered only after Sol approves the claim, alpha, sample size assumptions and missingness rule. Multiclass decision labels: report confusion matrices and per-class counts descriptively; no unapproved chi-square or class-wise tests. Continuous latency/resource measures: report raw paired observations and descriptive paired differences/medians; no unapproved t-test, rank test, interval, or tail claim.

B_end_to_end_system_comparison.primary_claim: For executable assigned cases scored blind under a frozen rubric, report system-level task-outcome counts and paired differences versus the frozen Rules-plus-executor configuration. Descriptive only until a separately justified inferential design is approved.
B_end_to_end_system_comparison.primary_metric: task outcome success = rubric-passing outputs / executable cases assigned to the system, with system-attributable output failures counted as failures
B_end_to_end_system_comparison.paired_case_semantics: Systems receive the same case ID and rubric; each may receive only its pinned adapter-supported inputs. Pair case outcomes, but interpret as whole-system differences. Do not attribute differences to router alone when input, adapter, executor, or model pair differs.
B_end_to_end_system_comparison.inferential_method_boundary: Binary paired outcome: exact McNemar may be considered only after preregistration and Sol review. Multiclass outcome/failure classes: descriptive counts and confusion tables only. Continuous latency/resource/cost: raw paired case values and descriptive summaries only. No inferential test or acceptance threshold is currently authorized.

claim_hierarchy.sample_size: NOT_YET_JUSTIFIED: no target effect/precision objective, expected discordance or variance, outcome prevalence, alpha, power, multiplicity family, strata/clustering assumptions, or expected unscorable rate is supported by independent evidence. Phase 0's 12 exposed synthetic dev cases cannot justify formal n.
claim_hierarchy.alpha_power_and_thresholds: NOT_YET_JUSTIFIED; no alpha, power, effect size, non-inferiority margin, acceptance threshold, or confirmatory confidence interval is invented or approved.
claim_hierarchy.unknown_denominator_rule: Assigned cases remain in flow accounting. For an outcome-specific metric, exclude only cases whose gold/measurement is genuinely UNKNOWN from that metric's scorable denominator; publish assigned, eligible, scored, UNKNOWN, and failure counts and rates. System-attributable missing/corrupt output is failure. Non-system missing evidence is UNKNOWN, retained in flow counts. Never recode UNKNOWN as success or safe.
claim_hierarchy.multiplicity: No secondary metric is confirmatory. Secondary metrics and strata are descriptive only; no multiplicity correction is claimed or needed for descriptive reporting. Before any inferential secondary claim, Sol must freeze the test family and correction procedure; otherwise label exploratory/descriptive.
descriptive_only: any comparison using provisional or UNKNOWN gold
all Track B differences where system components differ

heldout_governance.status: PROTOCOL_ONLY; population quotas, exact sample count, named data owner and unseal authorization await independent review
heldout_governance.custodian_role: HELDOUT_CUSTODIAN: a named person appointed by the data owner, independent of router/adapter/executor implementation, tuning, and candidate selection. If one person cannot satisfy the separation, a separate data owner must appoint and audit the role.

may_see_content: independent route-gold adjudicators for route cases assigned to them
independent outcome adjudicators for anonymized output and the minimum task context required to score
frozen runner process only after written unseal authorization; no interactive implementer access
must_not_see_content_before_unseal: benchmark operators outside the frozen runner
access.implementer_after_unseal: No direct prompt, label, per-case digest, or result access until all systems and configs are irreversibly locked; any exposure/change retires that heldout version for confirmatory use.
access.reviewer_visibility: Independent reviewer may inspect protocol, role assignments, access logs, commitment and non-revealing manifest fields. Prompt bytes and per-case prompt digests stay sealed until authorized unseal.

heldout_governance.population: Newly authored or lawfully sampled, de-identified English and Chinese task requests representative of the Router Lab's explicitly declared local-first routing use cases; exclude confidential/private source text unless separately authorized and protected. Population definition requires data-owner and Sol review before generation.
strata: language: zh, en, mixed only when both languages are supported
task family: structured transformation, information extraction/classification, short-form reasoning/response; exact families to be confirmed from target population
heldout_governance.sample_frame: Purpose-authored cases or an approved, rights-cleared source frame frozen before generation; no Phase 0 case, paraphrase, benchmark item, or model-output-derived item. Exact source, quotas, sample count, inclusion/exclusion criteria, and rights remain NOT_YET_JUSTIFIED and require approval before generation.
generation_protocol: Freeze population, strata, quotas, inclusion/exclusion criteria, language policy, scoring rubrics, executor/model identities and authoring recipe before case creation.
Custodian generates or samples cases only after adapter/configuration lock; candidate outputs may not be used to author, filter, rewrite or select cases.
Record provenance, rights, authoring method/version, timestamps, inclusion decisions and contamination review for every case.
Assign one random opaque UUID per case; never derive IDs from content or reuse IDs across splits.

Store prompt bytes as exact UTF-8 with a declared LF policy. Compute prompt SHA-256 over exact bytes and router-input SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false); keep digests private until unseal.
heldout_governance.sealing: Store prompt, labels, per-case digests and access events in a private access-controlled store. Create a signed or append-only manifest with dataset version, case UUIDs, generation/source details, rubric and protocol versions, file-level and per-case digests, timestamps and access log. Publish only a non-revealing commitment before evaluation. Never commit formal heldout content or its per-case prompt digests to this repository.
heldout_governance.case_id: Random opaque UUIDv4 allocated by custodian once; independent of prompt contents; no reuse across splits.

digests.prompt: SHA-256 exact UTF-8 prompt bytes with frozen line endings
digests.router_input: SHA-256 canonical UTF-8 JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false) for the actual per-track/per-adapter payload; Controlled payload excludes task prompt

heldout_governance.overlap_contamination: Before sealing, compare exact bytes, normalized text and token/character n-gram fingerprints against all Phase 0 case/prompt material and each declared source benchmark; manually adjudicate likely paraphrases. Record hits, resolutions and benchmark/pretraining uncertainty. This cannot prove absence from model pretraining.
heldout_governance.blind_route_gold: Two independent adjudicators receive only policy version and permitted metadata, not prompts beyond what is necessary, router identity/decisions, or outcomes. They label independently; third blind adjudicator resolves disagreement. Preserve both labels, rationale and resolution. Unresolvable gold remains UNKNOWN.
heldout_governance.blind_task_outcome: Two reviewers independently score anonymized outputs using the frozen itemized rubric without router/system identity or route decision; third reviewer resolves disagreement. Preserve raw scores and resolution. A missing/corrupt system-attributable output is failure; otherwise UNKNOWN with reason.
heldout_governance.unknown_handling: Never coerce UNKNOWN. Route-gold UNKNOWN is excluded from decision-correctness denominator but remains in assigned/eligible flow counts. Outcome UNKNOWN is excluded from success denominator only when evidence is not attributable to the system; retain it in the flow table. Missing risk/sensitivity stays fail-closed and is not recoded safe.
heldout_governance.unseal_authorization: No unseal in this gate. Later release requires written independent Sol approval of the exact packet and a separate explicit execution authorization; all candidate, license, adapter, runner, executor, config, environment and budget gates must pass. Custodian records authorizer, scope, manifest commitment/digest, time and recipients.

adapter_runner_executor_identity.routing_contract: Canonical UTF-8 JSON request validated against routing-v0 semantics; adapter capability declaration lists accepted fields and rejects unsupported/missing required fields. Controlled requests never contain task text.
adapter_runner_executor_identity.adapter_interface: predict(request: RoutingRequest, *, candidate_ref: ExactCandidateRef, config_ref: ConfigRef) -> DecisionReceipt; every returned target must be checked by the deterministic policy guard against risk, confidentiality, opt-in and available_targets.
adapter_runner_executor_identity.adapter_identity: Not implemented. Before any run record adapter semantic version, source git commit, adapter source-tree SHA-256, interface version and dependency-lock digest. Laya constructor must require the exact checkpoint repository and revision; mismatch aborts before inference.
adapter_runner_executor_identity.runner_identity: Not implemented. Before a run record runner version, source git commit, source-tree SHA-256, CLI invocation, case-order digest and receipt schema version.
adapter_runner_executor_identity.executor_identity: No executor selected. Before End-to-End work record executor implementation/version, exact model repository/revision, separate license, decoding/config, local endpoint identity and output contract. No executor may be silently substituted.
adapter_runner_executor_identity.config_identity: Canonical JSON config digest, policy/rules version, adapter settings, thresholds if any, model-pair mapping and execution limits; thresholds require separate justification/review.
adapter_runner_executor_identity.environment_identity: Canonical digest over OS/WSL identity, Python implementation/version, lockfile digest, installed package inventory, CPU/RAM/GPU/driver, environment variables affecting execution, network mode and cache identity. Secrets are never included.

MAX_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_COUNT.basis: One Laya multilingual checkpoint revision only; do not download RouteLLM or vLLM assets.

MAX_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_BYTES.basis: Laya Hub reports 647 MB at upstream; allow modest metadata/shard variance while bounding one checkpoint. Exact bytes must be read from revision metadata before authorization.

MAX_DISK_USAGE.basis: 8 GiB total Stage B experiment footprint, including model, CPU dependencies, cache, logs and temporary files; small relative to 891 GiB currently available and intended only for one feasibility candidate.

MAX_WALL_CLOCK.basis: Two hours total for one bounded install/load/adapter feasibility session; no benchmark sweep.

MAX_FULL_BENCHMARK_RERUNS.basis: Stage B target is feasibility only; a formal full benchmark is outside this packet and requires new review.

MAX_FEASIBILITY_CASES.basis: At most six existing public Phase 0 dev cases for adapter plumbing only; not a sample-size claim, heldout set, or performance pilot result.

USER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Approve or revise each proposed positive resource cap before any model/dependency download or candidate execution.
Approve exact Laya artifact byte count and CPU-only/GPU policy after immutable revision metadata and lock plan are reviewed.
Approve whether a six-case public-dev feasibility smoke is within the later Stage B authorization; it must remain non-inferential and not be presented as performance evidence.
Appoint named HELDOUT_CUSTODIAN and data owner; approve population, exact strata quotas/sample frame/rights, and formal sample size before any heldout generation.
Sol High must choose either a fully justified formal inferential design or keep all results descriptive; set no margin/threshold without evidence.

stop_conditions.action: Abort before inference, invalidate affected receipts, and review. No latest/main/floating reference is acceptable.

stop_conditions.action: Stop immediately, disable network, preserve logs, and review; paid API budget is zero.

stop_conditions.condition: policy invariant break: confidential-to-cloud, unavailable target, or unknown/high-risk fail-open
stop_conditions.action: Stop affected run immediately; do not offset with quality metrics.
Stop candidate after one bounded repair; environment/config changes require review before retry.
Stop immediately and preserve partial receipts; no automatic cap increase.

stop_conditions.action: Stop that candidate and return to review; maximum one repair for a root cause, no reset by renaming the issue.

stop_conditions.action: Stop before request; no paid or remote fallback.
